items.source: When this flag is set to true messages within the same session will be sent to the "clientInboundChannel" one at a time in order to preserve the order in which they were received.
items.translation: 当此标志设置为 `true` 时，同一会话中的消息将按接收顺序逐个发送到 `"clientInboundChannel"`，以保留其接收顺序。

items.source: By default messages sent to the "clientInboundChannel" may be handled in parallel and not in the same order as they were received because the channel is backed by a ThreadPoolExecutor that in turn does not guarantee processing in order.
items.translation: 默认情况下，发送到 `"clientInboundChannel"` 的消息可能会并行处理，且处理顺序与接收顺序不一致，因为该通道由 `ThreadPoolExecutor` 支持，而后者不保证按序处理。

items.source: By default this is set to 1.
items.translation: 默认情况下，该值设置为 1。

items.source: use of PathMatcher and UrlPathHelper is deprecated for use at runtime in web modules in favor of parsed patterns with PathPatternParser.
items.translation: 使用 PathMatcher 和 UrlPathHelper 已弃用，在 Web 模块中运行时建议使用通过 PathPatternParser 解析的模式。

items.source: Configure a customized UrlPathHelper for the STOMP endpoint HandlerMapping.
items.translation: 为 STOMP 端点 HandlerMapping 配置自定义的 UrlPathHelper。

items.source: Set the order of the HandlerMapping used for STOMP endpoints relative to other Spring MVC handler mappings.
items.translation: 设置用于 STOMP 端点的 `HandlerMapping` 相对于其他 Spring MVC 处理器映射的顺序。

items.source: Register a STOMP over WebSocket endpoint at the given mapping path.
items.translation: 在指定的映射路径处注册一个基于 WebSocket 的 STOMP 端点。

items.source: Configure a handler for customizing or handling STOMP ERROR frames to clients.
items.translation: 配置一个用于自定义或处理发往客户端的 STOMP ERROR 帧的处理程序。

items.source: A contract for registering STOMP over WebSocket endpoints.
items.translation: 用于在 WebSocket 端点上注册 STOMP 的合约。

items.source:
Whether to handle client messages sequentially in the order in which
they were received.
items.translation: 是否按接收顺序依次处理客户端消息。
